title: Lakefront Loop with Kessie
description: Kessie crushed the lakefront today. She jumped over every puddle, every curb, every obstacle in her path. If she jumps, she jumps.

title: Snack Break Run with Buddy
description: Buddy stopped at every food smell in Bay View. We passed a taco truck and I thought I lost him. This little guy runs on treats and vibes.

title: Park Dash with Goldburger
description: Goldburger was in peak form today. Fast, athletic, and yes — he tried to hump a fire hydrant. Twice. We love him anyway.

title: Sunset Sprint with Biscuit
description: Biscuit's little legs were MOVING. Sunset on the Oak Leaf Trail with a Corgi who runs like his dinner depends on it. Viva la Munch.
